'''Hu Hongwen''' ({{zh|s=胡宏纹|p=Hú Hóngwén}}; 16 March 1925 – 19 May 2016) was a Chinese [[organic chemist]], educator and an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] (CAS). He was known as the [[Editor-in-chief|Chief editor]] of Chinese higher education textbook ''Organic Chemistry''.<ref>{{cite news|title=著名有机化学家胡宏纹院士逝世 享年91岁|url=http://tech.163.com/16/0522/08/BNLJUJ7900094O5H.html |access-date=23 May 2016|publisher=Netease|date=22 May 2016|language=Chinese}}</ref>

Hu died on 19 May 2016 at the age of 91 in [[Nanjing]].<ref>{{cite news|title=有机化学家胡宏纹院士逝世 享年91岁|url=http://news.sciencenet.cn/htmlnews/2016/5/346757.shtm |access-date=23 May 2016|publisher=sciencenet.cn|date=23 May 2016|language=Chinese}}</ref>
